name: Ngo Dinh Diem
role: President of South Vietnam from 1955 to 1963

checks.lead: Ngô Đình Diệm ( dyem,  YEE-əm or  zeem; Vietnamese: [ŋō ɗìn jîəmˀ] ; 3 January 1901 – 2 November 1963) was a South Vietnamese politician. He was the final prime minister of the State of Vietnam (1954–1955), and later the first president of South Vietnam (Republic of Vietnam) from 1955 until his capture and assassination during the CIA-backed 1963 coup d'état.
